texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Current Company: Palo Alto AI Research Lab (Founder); Platinum VC & Incubator (Co-Founder)
texts.Why do you believe you're a good fit for: I have spent the last three years building AI-trust tooling adjacent to what GPTZero productizes: my verbatim-citation-gate (MIT, public) is a zero-token gate plus a burden-of-proof judge that catches fabricated RAG citations - the same 'is this text actually grounded?' problem approached from the verification side. As founder of Palo Alto AI Research Lab I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet in public with published reliability evals (0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs). Product background: 10+ years as a venture founder owning problem framing, roadmap and GTM; product owner for a 40+ engineer distributed org; built and ran an AI-native CRM used daily by up to 30 operators. I also publish academically (136 citations, h-index 7), so I speak the language of GPTZero's education and academic-integrity users.
texts.What is one feature you would be excited: An evidence-first explanation mode: alongside the AI-probability score, attach per-span evidence (which signals contributed, plus verifiable citation checks) so an educator can see why a passage was flagged. I built a similar burden-of-proof judge for RAG citation fabrication (verbatim-citation-gate), and in my experience the explainability step is what turns skeptical users into adopters.
